topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: Covers of deceit, I’ve seen 'em all. Little Miss Innocent over there, thought she could pull the wool over everyone's eyes, cancelling the surprise with a trembling lip and a tear in her eye. Like I wouldn’t see through that a mile away. Took one look at her setup, the half-hearted apologies, the poorly concealed smirks. Made my decision quick. Sorted it out, got to the bottom of her little game. Now, everyone knows exactly what they’re dealing with. No more masks, no more lies. Clean, straightforward. The way things should be. The way I made them.
